documented_not_shown.title: Trace G/L account usage in finance reports
documented_not_shown.text: Financial report authors can now identify uncategorized accounts, trace account usage and calculations, and preview definitions before publishing. Learn more in Design your own financial reports .

documented_not_shown.title: Use conditional visibility in the updated Word add-in
documented_not_shown.text: Design document reports layouts with conditional visibility using the new HideIf logic control in the Word add-in. documented_not_shown.text: With the new data model for table extensions, all fields on an AL table are stored in the same table in the database. This gives faster performance on all database operations that involve table extensions. Learn more in Extension objects in the same app .

videos.title: What's new in AL and Tools

shown_not_documented.summary: A field type can be changed from integer to big integer while keeping existing rows, aimed at ledger or sequence entries that run out of numbers. The compiler, AppSourceCop and the comparison with the previous app version show warnings such as implicit conversion and possible runtime overflow, but the change is allowed without copying data or a parallel implementation.

shown_not_documented.summary: Resources stored in an app can be shared across app boundaries by marking resource folders as public. Other apps can list apps with public resources, list resources per app ID and get them as JSON or text by passing the provider app ID, without a dependency. Private resources still work with the normal functions without an app ID.
